pages.text: $(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)entity_resistances.json$() sets per-type resistance per entity ID. Positive = vulnerable (takes more), negative = resistant, 0 = normal.$(br2)$(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)armor_resistances.json$() does the same per armor piece. $(o)protect enchantments add 5%/level after armor resistance and before armor value reduction$().

$(2)Two-stage independent reduction$()$(br)Base resistance -> enchantment resistance -> vanilla armor value, multiplied stage by stage. Armor tooltips list non-zero resistances sorted descending; red = vulnerable, green = resistant.
